Sutras first, part 1: the Sutra tag on the Trick page, Star, Try a trick, Katas, Arena, Watch and games, and the Sutra cards' kid lines (js/sutras.js). The tag loads on demand (owner, 2026-10-26, from the review): js/sutra-tag.js (2,823 bytes) is out of the static import graph of js/app.js and counts here only as a precached file; the views draw through js/sutra-tag-slot.js (new, 703 bytes), which holds the tag's place until the module is here and is loaded a second after the page has loaded. The static graph is 1,768 bytes smaller than with the tag imported statically (295,631 to 293,863 bytes, 57 modules); the total grows 1,227 bytes over that version (806,122) for the slot module, its calls and the placeholder styles. Growth over main: js/app.js, js/star.js, js/arena.js, js/mental.js, js/try.js, math.css; measured on main as of #131, so that code is the only growth

Sutras first, part 2: progress per Sutra (js/sutra-progress.js, new, 1,066 bytes) as a line and meter on each Sutra card and on the Deep dive (js/app.js, math.css), Sutra scholar listed to Explorer (js/gamify.js), and Sutras first in the menu, Find and the Guide in every Mode (js/find.js, js/guide.js, js/play/catalog.js, play/index.html); no tag is drawn by a static import of js/sutra-tag.js (the #126 code split stays); and content-visibility: auto on each verse group at the end of the Sutras page (math.css), so the groups off screen under an open Deep dive skip layout and paint: without it the Deep dive's blocking time read 200 ms against production's 174 in the perf job (limit 199).
